configuration: default RV32IMAF_Zicsr_Zifencei plan with active one-MSHR L1I shared-demand slice, partial M3 L1D dirty/write-allocate, clean/dirty exclusive L1D-L2 transfer, four L2 demand-read MSHRs, ID-5 dirty-victim writeback, ID-7 RV32A, and exact-head 1-4 beat device slices
known_omissions: DeviceStrong and 1-4 beat DeviceBurstable accesses are connected through the LSQ/ROB and AXI ID 6; ID-7 RV32A is executable. L1I is an active one-MSHR shared-demand client, but it has no resident I-side L2 lookup, formal proof, or I/D coherence. L1D has dirty/write-allocate and transfers clean/dirty victims to the exclusive L2 store; four retained L2 demand-read owners map client tokens to IDs 1-4 and ID-5 dirty-victim writeback is executable. Trace-only host flush is excluded from this production ledger; general dirty-cache flush/FENCE semantics and external coherency are not implemented
ROB, BDB, predictor, rename-map, free-list, ready-table, and completion control bits are not yet fully inventoried
IQ valid, age, replay, wakeup-CAM, and selector proxies are not yet included
memory ingress buffers, completion buffers, full dual-LSU conflict logic, and the final cache hierarchy control proxies are not yet fully inventoried
